finding: Hong Kong eShop carries exactly 9 Witcher 3 (Switch 1) language packs, all free (0 HKD), all onsale. 5 are for languages NOT included in the HK Complete Edition base game (HK store lists base languages as Traditional Chinese / Simplified Chinese / English / Korean), and are the most likely 5 in shawn's eShop App screenshot (likelyInScreenshot=true). The other 4 are Korean/Chinese packs (already included in the CE base) under both the standard and Complete Edition lineages; they are included here because they are the same game's HK language packs, equally missing from the DB, and the screenshot's exact 5 cannot be proven from outside the app.
